steps.en: Officer selects several court notices for a bulk decision
steps.id: Officer memilih beberapa court notice untuk bulk decision
steps.why_en: The staff portal has no screen to select many court notices at once.
steps.why_id: Staff portal tidak punya layar untuk memilih banyak court notice sekaligus.

steps.en: Officer enters the composition amount for the selected notices
steps.id: Officer mengisi composition amount untuk notice yang dipilih
steps.why_en: No composition amount input exists for court notices; only a per-notice UPL form has one.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada input composition amount untuk court notice; hanya form UPL per notice yang punya.

steps.en: Officer sets the payment due date for the selected notices
steps.id: Officer menentukan payment due date untuk notice yang dipilih
steps.why_en: Due date is only filled by an external system, not by the officer in the portal.
steps.why_id: Due date hanya diisi sistem eksternal, bukan oleh officer di portal.

steps.en: Officer enables or disables payment acceptance for the selected notices
steps.id: Officer mengaktifkan atau menonaktifkan penerimaan pembayaran untuk notice yang dipilih
steps.why_en: Only external systems can set the flag in bulk; the portal just displays it.
steps.why_id: Hanya sistem eksternal yang bisa set flag massal; portal hanya menampilkannya.
